description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Interchange_Id, which models a directive ID in the interchange format for the HTMLPurifier configuration schema. It includes constructor, conversion, parsing, and static factory methods for managing directive IDs.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Interchange_Id

methods.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Interchange_Id::toString
methods.description: Returns the key string, representing the ID.

methods.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Interchange_Id::getRootNamespace
methods.description: Extracts the root namespace portion of the ID key.

methods.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Interchange_Id::getDirective
